verdict.rationale: Nix is a command-line tool with a documented official CLI (`nix build`, `nix run`, `nix develop`). It has a scriptable non-interactive installer and an official `nixos/nix` Docker image. Remote builds and binary caches also support running it headlessly in automated pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit first-party CI integration docs (e.g., CI-provider setup or non-interactive/automation guidance), plus independent hands-on reports of CI use; the only community mention is a speculative remark that it could suit automated systems.
